papers.title_en: Consistency of variational approximations under bounded Kullback--Leibler divergence
papers.authors: Hien Duy Nguyen, Jacob Westerhout, Thomas Guilmeau, Julyan Arbel
papers.evidence: 有界KL散度下变分近似的一致性——直接相关于深度学习中的变分推理
papers.tldr: 变分近似广泛应用于贝叶斯推断中近似后验分布，但其一致性理论尚不完善。该研究在一般度量空间上证明，若近似分布与目标后验的Kullback-Leibler散度一致有界且目标序列紧致，则近似序列也紧致。进而当目标后验弱收敛到真实参数时，任何KL散度有界的变分序列也一致收敛。还给出了简单的对数矩条件验证该有界性，并应用于光滑广义后验分布。该工作为变分近似的一致性提供了通用理论保证。
papers.abstract_en: Variational methods are widely used to approximate posterior distributions in Bayesian inference when exact computation is infeasible. We study when such approximations inherit posterior consistency. Our first result shows that, on a general metric space, a uniform bound on the Kullback--Leibler divergence from the approximating measures to a tight sequence of target measures forces the approximating sequence to be tight. It follows that if the target posteriors converge weakly to a Dirac mass at the true parameter, then any variational sequence with bounded Kullback--Leibler divergence to the targets is also consistent. We also give simple logarithmic-moment conditions that verify this boundedness condition, and illustrate them for smooth generalised posterior distributions.

papers.title_en: A Stabilized Path-Space Approach to Diffusion-Based Posterior Sampling
papers.authors: Evan Scope Crafts, Umberto Villa, Saviz Mowlavi, Yanting Ma, Hassan Mansour, Wael H. Ali
papers.evidence: 基于扩散的后验采样用于贝叶斯反问题及不确定性量化
papers.tldr: 扩散模型后验采样常因启发式引导在非线性逆问题中失效。本文提出稳定路径空间框架，将后验采样转化为受控随机过程学习，通过时间重参数化消除偏差并采用信任域优化求解控制。该框架统一多种采样方法，可量化误差并提供渐近精确后验估计。在基准逆问题上验证了更高精度与鲁棒性。
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion models provide expressive data-driven priors for Bayesian inverse problems, but many diffusion posterior samplers rely on heuristic guidance approximations that can fail for nonlinear operators and multimodal posteriors. In this work, we develop a stabilized path-space framework for diffusion-based posterior sampling. Starting from a base diffusion process whose terminal marginal represents the prior, we define a likelihood-weighted target measure on trajectories and cast posterior sampling as learning a controlled stochastic process whose path measure matches this target. This formulation connects diffusion posterior sampling to stochastic optimal control while preserving the Bayesian structure needed for uncertainty quantification. We introduce a time reparameterization that makes the path-space control problem well posed by removing the bias induced by the unknown initial value function, without auxiliary training. We then learn the control via a trust-region path-space optimization method with log-variance objectives. The path-space perspective also unifies our learned control approach with existing guidance-based samplers, quantifies the sampling error induced by approximate controls, and yields importance sampling corrections for asymptotically exact posterior expectations. We evaluate the proposed framework on a suite of benchmark inverse problems with analytically characterized or high-quality reference posteriors, enabling principled assessment of sampling accuracy and uncertainty quantification. These experiments provide insight into the behavior of diffusion-based posterior samplers and demonstrate improved accuracy and robustness over leading approaches.

papers.title_en: Multi-Label Test-Time Adaptation with Bayesian Conditional Priors
papers.authors: Qiru Li, Ao Zhou, Zhiwei Jiang, Zifeng Cheng, Cong Wang, Yafeng Yin, Qing Gu
papers.evidence: 贝叶斯条件先验用于多标签识别的测试时自适应
papers.tldr: 多标签识别在分布偏移下，标准零样本推理独立评分导致标签不连贯。本文提出贝叶斯条件先验估计（BCP），一种无梯度测试时适应方法，通过为每个测试图像选择高置信度锚标签并执行锚条件贝叶斯修正，显式促进兼容标签抑制不兼容标签。BCP在线从无标签测试流估计锚条件先验，仅增加极小的计算开销。在多个多标签基准和CLIP主干上，BCP显著提升mAP，如RN50从57.31到69.22，ViT-B/16从62.61到71.79，超越强基线。
papers.abstract_en: Multi-label recognition with frozen Vision-Language Models (VLMs) is brittle under distribution shift: standard zero-shot inference scores labels independently, ignoring co-occurrence structure and producing incoherent label sets where dominant concepts suppress weaker but compatible labels. We introduce Bayesian Conditional Priors (BCP) Estimation, a gradient-free test-time adaptation method that injects label dependency without tuning the backbone. BCP views zero-shot logits as a proxy for marginal posteriors under a fixed image-text likelihood and attributes shift-induced errors mainly to a mismatched label prior. For each test image, it selects a high-confidence anchor label and applies an anchor-conditioned Bayesian refinement. This update is closed-form in logit space and admits a pointwise mutual information (PMI) interpretation, explicitly promoting compatible labels and suppressing incompatible ones. BCP operates without target annotations by estimating anchor-conditioned priors online from the unlabeled test stream via lightweight second-order co-occurrence statistics, adding negligible overhead beyond a single forward pass. Across standard multi-label benchmarks and multiple CLIP backbones, BCP consistently outperforms strong TTA baselines, e.g., improving RN50 average mAP from 57.31 to 69.22 and ViT-B/16 from 62.61 to 71.79.

papers.title_en: A solvable model for unsupervised federated learning
papers.authors: Giovanni Catania, Aurélien Decelle, Gianluca Manzan, Beatriz Seoane, Daniele Tantari
papers.evidence: 推导了联邦学习中教师恢复的最优贝叶斯条件
papers.tldr: 本文针对无监督联邦学习提出可解理论模型，通过教师-多学生交互场景分析不同噪声或数据子集下的学习。利用平衡无序系统理论，证明学生间交互能提升学习性能，高噪声学生所需样本更少，低噪声学生与真实信号重叠更大。推导最优贝叶斯条件，数值模拟验证，并将动力学映射到受限玻尔兹曼机，为分布式生成建模提供理论理解。
papers.abstract_en: We introduce a theoretical framework for analyzing federated learning in a generative setting through a teacher-multiple interacting students scenario, in which each student receives a distinct realization of the data, either through a different noise corruption or by accessing a different subset, possibly of varying size. Using theoretical tools in equilibrium disordered system, we analytically show that interactions among students systematically enhance learning performance: highly noisy students require fewer samples to recover the underlying pattern, while low-noise students achieve a larger overlap with the ground-truth signal. We derive the optimal Bayesian conditions for teacher recovery as functions of the sample complexity, noise level, and interaction strength, and validate these predictions through numerical simulations. The resulting dynamics can be mapped onto equilibrium sampling in a Restricted Boltzmann Machine with a structured hidden layer, providing a principled theoretical understanding of how interactions improve distributed generative modeling.

papers.title_en: Hölder++: Improving the Quality-Coherence Trade-off in Multimodal VAEs
papers.authors: Huyen Vo, María Martínez-García, Isabel Valera
papers.evidence: 多模态变分自编码器改进质量-连贯性权衡
papers.tldr: 多模态VAE面临生成质量与语义一致性的权衡问题。现有方法如MMVAE+使用近似Hölder pooling虽提升一致性但降低多样性。本文提出Hölder++，首次实现无近似Hölder pooling，并扩展模型分离共享与私有表示，结合层次化推理增强解耦。实验表明，Hölder++在生成质量和一致性上均优于现有方法，潜在空间更结构化，共享表示对下游任务有益。
papers.abstract_en: Existing approaches for multimodal variational autoencoders (VAEs) face a trade-off between generative quality and coherence-i.e., they struggle to generate realistic and diverse samples that, at the same time, are semantically consistent across modalities. A recent work shows that using a simple approximation to Hölder pooling as an aggregation method improves coherence over the SOTA MMVAE+, despite assuming a single shared representation across all modalities. Yet, it slightly compromises sample diversity. Inspired by this insight, we propose Hölder++, a novel multimodal VAE that improves the generative quality-coherence trade-off through: (i) the first implementation of Hölder pooling without any approximation for multimodal VAEs; (ii) an extended architecture that models distinct shared and private (i.e., modality-specific) representations (Hölder+); and (iii) hierarchical inference that further enhances the disentanglement between the shared and private representations (Hölder++). Our experiments corroborate that Hölder++ consistently improves the generative quality-coherence trade-off, yields more structured latent spaces, and learns shared representations that are informative for downstream tasks.
